templates.projectReadme:
# {{modName}}

Minecraft {{mcVersion}} / NeoForge {{loaderVersion}} mod, generated by mcmodkit from a ModSpec.

## Build

```
gradlew.bat build      # Windows
./gradlew build        # macOS / Linux
```

The mod jar is written to build/libs/. Requires JDK {{javaVersion}}; the first build downloads NeoForge and Minecraft (several hundred MB).

## Run

`gradlew.bat runClient` / `runServer` start a development client/server with the mod loaded.

{{TEXTURE_NOTES}}

## Iterate

Edit the ModSpec JSON and regenerate: mcmodkit overwrites the files it manages and never touches your own files.

notes: Registration uses DeferredRegister + DeferredHolder on the mod event bus (NeoForge), unlike Fabric's direct Registry.register.
Mappings are Mojang official (ModDevGradle default): no mappings dependency to pin.
Datapack directories are plural on 1.20.4: data/<ns>/loot_tables/... and data/minecraft/tags/blocks/... The singular spellings are a 1.21 change.
Textures are not generated: add 16x16 PNGs under assets/<ns>/textures/{item,block}/<id>.png.

maven.neoforged.net is unreachable on some networks (TLS reset). settings.gradle resolves plugins from the ForgeCDN mirror (neoforged.forgecdn.net) and synthesizes a local net.neoforged:minecraft-dependencies:<mc> POM from Mojang's version manifest, cached under .gradle/mcdeps-repo. The main host is deliberately absent: Gradle hard-fails on an unreachable repository instead of falling through.

Requires JDK 17 to compile the mod, but NFRT's createMinecraftArtifacts runs on a JDK 21 toolchain: run Gradle itself on a JDK 21 (its current-JVM detection covers the 21 toolchain) and let auto-detection find JDK 17.

Compile + runtime verified on the authoring machine: gradle build passes and a dedicated server boots with the mod loaded (scripts/verify-runtime.mjs). Getting there required: MDG 2.0.147 (MDG 1.x/NFRT 1.x hardcodes --release 21, producing class-65 inputs for the Java 17 toolchain), a pinned-library manifest hook in build.gradle (NFRT recompiles Minecraft from NeoForge's userdev config that pins exact library versions; Gradle's conflict resolution upgrades them and NFRT would then fetch the missing pinned ones from the blocked host), META-INF/mods.toml (FML 2.x scans only that filename, not neoforge.mods.toml), and loaderVersion "[2,)" (FML 2.0.17's javafml language version is 2.0; "[4,)" makes the loader discover the mod and then reject it with "Missing language javafml").

MDG 2.x wires the mod into legacy userdev runs through the MOD_CLASSES environment variable (FML 2.0.17 splits entries on %% and the platform path separator), so no modLocator rework is needed on 1.20.4.
Item construction goes through ITEMS.register(name, supplier) so the spec can pick an item class (itemBehaviors). registerSimpleItem cannot express a custom class.
Derived from neoforge-1.21.1, re-fitted with facts from scripts/version-facts.mjs (loader 20.4.251, pack_format 22 read from the real game jar).

SCOPE: items + blocks + textures only. UI/recipes/advancements/entities/datagen are deliberately absent because their templates are not version-independent (1.21.2+ alone changed MobRenderer's arity and EntityType.Builder#build). Asking for them fails with a clear error rather than emitting broken Java.
ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath does not exist before 1.21; 1.20.x uses the public constructor new ResourceLocation(ns, path). Caught by the compiler, not by review.
